constituent_counties.11001: District of Columbia, District of Columbia

qcew_annual_2023_2025.csv.dataset: Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW)
qcew_annual_2023_2025.csv.method: BLS annual area CSVs, all published source rows concatenated for 2023, 2024 and 2025. Original values and flags preserved; city_name and metro_cbsa added. 2025 contains only all-industry/all-ownership total.

cbp_employment_2023.csv.units: Employees; payroll in thousand USD; establishments
cbp_employment_2023.csv.method: Official CB2300CBP metro response, all returned broad-industry and employment-size rows for the target CBSA and YEAR=2023. All original field names and flags preserved; no extra industry/size filter.

economic_census_2022_detail.csv.gz.units: Revenue and payroll in thousand USD; employees; establishments
economic_census_2022_detail.csv.gz.method: Official EC2200BASIC metro response, all returned target-CBSA 2022 detail rows. NAICS2022 and NAICS2022_LABEL renamed NAICS_CODE and NAICS_LABEL; NAICS_VINTAGE=2022 added; JSON nulls serialized as blanks. No suppressed value imputed.

economic_census_2022_sectors.csv.dataset: 2022 Economic Census: All Sectors Summary Statistics (EC2200BASIC)
economic_census_2022_sectors.csv.units: Revenue and payroll in thousand USD; employees; establishments
economic_census_2022_sectors.csv.method: Same EC2200BASIC response, target CBSA, TYPOP=00, TAXSTAT=00, NAICS2022 in 22;31-33;42;44-45;48-49;51;52;53;54;56;61;62;71;72;81. Same documented renames and null serialization as detail.

bea_county_gdp_2023_2024.csv.method: Official BEA CAGDP2 rows for every July 2023 OMB constituent county, reshaped to years 2023 and 2024; all industry lines and source markers retained. Adds only complete all-industry metro sums, marked geo_type=metro and value_status=derived_sum_of_counties. SAGDP2N is a state table, so CAGDP2 matches county GDP. BEA’s 18 reporting areas cover all 23 OMB constituent counties/county equivalents; retain the source combined Virginia area codes 51919, 51942 and 51951. All component counties/cities belong wholly to the target metro; do not create separate component estimates. See bea_reporting_area_to_constituent_fips.

state_corporate_tax_2026.csv.dataset: State Corporate Income Tax Rates and Brackets, 2026
state_corporate_tax_2026.csv.method: Transcribe the 2026 table only, one row for every July 2023 OMB constituent state (including DC). Numeric field stores the highest published statutory rate; source_display retains every listed bracket. Washington 0 explicitly encodes no corporate income tax, not absence of other business taxes. Do not average states.

fortune500_headquarters_2025.csv.method: Public data.csv linked by map/app.js on Fortune’s 2025 interactive. Select headquarters points inside the target 2023 Census CBSA polygon. Retain reported national rank, company and municipality. Decode the one legacy Mac Roman accented name to UTF-8; trim incidental name whitespace. The 17-column schema is preserved. Current-headquarters fields remain blank unless independently verified; no such complete audit was performed. Preserve known publisher-location conflicts with explicit row status and notes. When the publisher location omits a state abbreviation, the state field is inferred from the reported municipality and assigned metro geography; it is not an independently verified address.

cbp_establishments_2023.csv.dataset: County Business Patterns: Number of Establishments (ESTAB)
cbp_establishments_2023.csv.method: Establishment-specific projection of the same official CB2300CBP metro response as row 2; target CBSA and YEAR=2023; preserves ESTAB and flags, NAICS2017, LFO, EMPSZES and their labels.

bds_metro_2023.csv.method: Official BDSMETRO response, target CBSA and YEAR=2023. All returned total/broad industry rows and every original measure/flag retained. Same single-year window as Dallas and Denver.

flags.QCEW: N in disclosure_code indicates nondisclosure; retain source zero but do not interpret it as a measured zero. Ownership and industry totals overlap component rows.
flags.Census: Preserve every *_F flag and source zero. D=withheld, N=unavailable/not comparable, S=publication standard not met, X=not applicable where defined by the source. Check table-specific definitions. CBP *_N fields describe noise ranges.
flags.BEA: Non-numeric published markers, including (D) or (NA), are preserved in gdp_current_thousand_usd with value_status=source_flag. Only complete all-industry county totals are summed.
flags.Fortune: 2025 publisher-reported locations are assigned to Census 2023 CBSA polygons using the publisher coordinates. These are historical reported rosters, not a complete independent headquarters audit. Blank current-verification fields mean unknown. Seattle includes one explicitly disputed publisher location for Lululemon; exclude that row from independently validated headquarters counts.

overlap: Economic Census detail and sectors come from the same EC2200BASIC table and overlap.
CBP employment and establishment files are two views of the same source and must not be added together.
GDP county rows and derived metro totals overlap.
date_exceptions: 2022 Economic Census is explicitly requested and has a 2022 reference year; it is not 2023 revenue.
2025 headquarters rosters and 2026 tax observations remain separately dated from annual employment/output observations.
release_dates: Exact release dates are recorded where verified; otherwise source_vintage identifies the observed table, without asserting a publication date.
schema_notes: Column names and order match the Dallas/Denver files for each of the nine datasets. No saved pandas index column is present.
These are fixed matching reference windows, not a claim to have downloaded every publisher’s newest available release.
Raw source names differ across programs; only city labels/CBSA helpers, the documented Economic Census NAICS aliases, GDP reshape/aggregation, tax transcription and Fortune curation are standardized.

One row per constituent state in tax files; the numeric rate is the published top statutory rate where multiple brackets exist. source_display and notes retain the schedule. Washington state 0 means no corporate income tax, despite its gross receipts tax.

collection_batch.selection: First ten listed metros without an existing city_data folder.

geography_notes: GDP county membership follows the July 2023 OMB list. Each other federal program retains its native geography vintage; no geographic backcast is implied.

Fortune metro assignment is derived from publisher coordinates and 2023 Census cartographic CBSA polygons (500k). It does not independently verify the publisher headquarters address or all co-headquarters.
Amazon appears once at its Seattle location in the publisher map. Its Arlington co-headquarters is not added to this single-location roster; do not interpret absence as no regional presence.

BEA publishes 18 reporting areas covering all 23 OMB counties/county equivalents. Combined Virginia areas are 51919 = Fairfax County (51059), Fairfax city (51600), Falls Church city (51610); 51942 = Prince William County (51153), Manassas city (51683), Manassas Park city (51685); 51951 = Spotsylvania County (51177), Fredericksburg city (51630). These whole combinations are inside the target metro. Their source GeoFIPS and GeoName are retained with geo_type=county; no separate component GDP is fabricated.
